criteria.criterion: Every P3 and P4 line of the brief's worked example holds through the built binary with stub claude and copilot on PATH, doctor started with -C <root> from another directory: the row's result and its message exactly as the brief's tables give them.
criteria.evidence: doctor.go doctorPlugin and doctorCopilotPlugin messages match the brief's tables verbatim; TestDoctorPluginScopeP3 and TestDoctorCopilotPluginP4 assert them; the go check log is green.

criteria.criterion: P3: `claude plugin list --json` runs with the repository root as its working directory. An entry counts when its id starts with `vloop@`, its version is not empty or missing, and it is for this repository: scope user or absent, or a projectPath matching the root or its symlink-resolved path by trustKeyMatch (the entry's path is not resolved). A counted entry is enabled when its enabled is true and neither .claude/settings.json nor .claude/settings.local.json sets enabledPlugins["vloop@vloop"] to false; a settings file that is missing, unreadable, not an object, or whose enabledPlugins is not an object, is ignored for this. `<v>` is the version of the first enabled counted entry in the list's order. Violation: a project entry of another repository counted here.
criteria.evidence: doctor.go runPluginList sets cmd.Dir=root; doctorPlugin filters by prefix, version, scope/trustKeyMatch; pluginOptedOut handles both files and malformed input; the test covers another repo's entry, opt-out, bad settings, empty version and cwd.

criteria.criterion: P3's messages are exactly the brief's table: pass with no message; the version warning naming `claude plugin update vloop@vloop`; `installed but not enabled for this repository — …` naming `claude plugin enable vloop@vloop --scope project`; `/vloop:operate is not available in your interactive sessions — claude plugin install vloop@vloop --scope project …`; `cannot read claude plugin list --json: <error>` (stderr's text when there is one). The row stays where it is and is n/a without claude. Violation: a message that suggests `claude plugin enable` without a --scope, or presents a user-level change as required.
criteria.evidence: doctor.go:685-687 and the error branch; the row's position is unchanged and n/a without claude.

criteria.criterion: P4: a `copilot plugin` row appears exactly when doctor's `copilot` row does (copilotKeys plus agent.review-brief; not agent.verify with run.verify false, nor agent.second-review with run.second-review off), right after the plugin row and before gate edits (also when plugin is n/a for want of claude); it is n/a when the copilot row is a problem; no row when no key is copilot or the config cannot be read, and then copilot is never run. It runs `copilot plugin list --json` in the root with the environment as given (COPILOT_HOME included); an entry counts when its name is `vloop`; its messages are exactly the brief's P4 table.
criteria.evidence: doctor.go:~146 copilotRow is set with the same keys as the copilot row, placed between plugin and gate edits, n/a if copilotBad; TestDoctorCopilotPluginP4 and TestDoctorNoCopilotPluginRow.

criteria.criterion: vloop run's preflight does not compute the copilot plugin row: no `copilot plugin` command runs at a run's start, while the preflight keeps checking copilot as today.
criteria.evidence: doctor.go gates the row on runBrief == nil; TestPreflightRunsNoCopilotPluginList.

criteria.criterion: doctor runs no `claude plugin` or `copilot plugin` command other than `list --json` and writes nothing. No new module dependency.
criteria.evidence: The only exec is runPluginList with plugin list --json; there are no writes; go.mod is unchanged.

criteria.criterion: Committed tests in internal/cli/doctor_test.go hold every P3 and P4 worked-example line as a named test, with stub claude and copilot on PATH that print the JSON shown and record their working directory, each test checking it was the repository root (doctor run with -C <root> from another directory); a test shows the preflight runs no copilot plugin list. The `go` check runs them. Violation: the rows shipped with no committed test the check runs.
criteria.evidence: doctor_test.go has TestDoctorPluginScopeP3, TestDoctorCopilotPluginP4, TestDoctorNoCopilotPluginRow and TestPreflightRunsNoCopilotPluginList; the stubs record cwd and the tests check it; the go log is green.
